name: hdc-shopify-migration
title_zh: 迁移到 Shopify 前先跑一遍的本地体检单
tagline_zh: 原站数据乱不乱、图片链得全不全、URL 会不会断，本地先查完再动手。不用开 Shopify 后台。
tagline_en: Check your source site's data integrity, image links, and URL structure before touching Shopify. Run scripts.
why_zh: 把迁移从「赌运气」变成「看报告」：先扫本地仓库，再谈平台配置。问题在源头暴露。
why_en: Turns migration from a leap of faith into a checklist: audit locally first, configure later. Catch issues at the source, not.
limit_zh: 只做迁移前的本地静态检查与报告生成，不含实际数据导入、主题定制或 Shopify 端操作。需自行准备原站数据副本。
limit_en: Local static checks and report generation only. No data import, theme work, or Shopify-side actions. Requires a local copy of your source data and a.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: A pre-migration local audit kit for moving to Shopify
